objective: Preserve the actual complete configured read boundary in concurrent project publication, including read-only foreign projects, before normal hook integration.
requirements: One logical write project; independent physical source owners remain parallel.
Use caller-retained complete read views, not newly sampled latest heads.
Read-only project registration grants no source writer lease or publication authority.
Validate every original owner, incarnation, dependency closure and read capability before admission.
Bind original receipt and exact read-input digest in the same durable transaction; no successful ACK before that commit.
Persist no read capability, private journal, query-vector or foreign original body in the write project.
Share identical immutable read-input descriptors by content within each source; receipt bindings reference them.
Reject missing or reordered configured read projects, foreign grants, invalid cuts, changed retry input and corrupt durable bindings.
Retained old views remain unchanged after later publications, and fresh-process recovery returns the exact recorded boundary.
Recommendation and read dependency metadata cannot create Union/completed authority.
nativeChecks: Real loopback service, 80 sessions/16 write owners, read-only foreign project, full original/graph/reopen checks, replay idempotence and invalid input rejection.
cleanup: Delete ended DBs/caches/raw logs/unused executables after sealing compact records; no archives.
